▸ EmDash CMS Tutorial: Build Your First Site

💡 EmDash is an open-source, Astro-powered CMS providing real-time, type-safe content management optimized for Cloudflare’s serverless stack.

EmDash is an open-source, Astro-based CMS that leverages TypeScript and sandboxed plugins to provide a secure, passkey-first content management experience. The platform utilizes a decoupled publishing workflow with Portable Text (JSON) and Astro’s Live Content Collections, enabling real-time updates and full type safety through specialized hooks like `getEmDashCollection`. While natively optimized for Cloudflare’s serverless stack (D1, R2, and Workers), it maintains portability for Node.js environments and supports both SQLite and PostgreSQL. This architecture streamlines the developer experience by combining a CLI-driven setup with a direct database-to-render pipeline that eliminates the need for full site rebuilds during content updates.

📝 关键要点 (6 sections)
  • Architecture and Core Features: EmDash is an open-source, Astro-based CMS that replaces PHP with TypeScript and uses sandboxed plugins and structured JSON content. It prioritizes security with passkey-first authentication and offers native integration with Cloudflare’s serverless stack while remaining portable to Node.js.
  • Project Scaffolding: Developers can initialize a project using a CLI tool that configures templates for either Node.js or Cloudflare environments. The setup includes a local SQLite database and generates a critical encryption key for managing plugin secrets.
  • Authentication and Admin Setup: The CMS features a passwordless setup wizard that utilizes WebAuthn for passkey registration as the primary login method. The admin dashboard allows for immediate site configuration and content management without manual database provisioning.
  • Content Management Workflow: EmDash employs a decoupled publishing workflow where drafts and published versions are managed separately in the database, allowing for live updates without site rebuilds. It supports revisions and scheduled publishing through a direct database-to-render pipeline.
  • Data Fetching and Type Safety: The system leverages Astro’s Live Content Collections and specialized hooks like `getEmDashCollection` to fetch content with full TypeScript support. Content is stored as Portable Text (JSON), ensuring it can be rendered across different platforms using a standard UI component.
  • Deployment Strategies: While optimized for Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2, EmDash can also be deployed to any Node.js server using SQLite or PostgreSQL. Deployment involves using the Wrangler CLI for serverless environments, though local content must be migrated manually to production databases.

The guide outlines the standard workflow for initializing or cloning repositories while emphasizing long-term maintenance through automated update commands. Finally, it addresses critical architectural considerations, such as resolving PATH conflicts and choosing between native Git for Windows or a WSL-based environment.

  • 可以通过设置font-style: normal来重置或移除斜体效果。
  • 如果网页字体没有提供专门的斜体文件，浏览器会生成“伪斜体”，因此建议加载真实的斜体字体文件或使用变量字体。
